definition.@DataWarehouse.sqlEditor.query:
SELECT
  b."BATCH_ID",
  CURRENT_UTCTIMESTAMP () AS "LOAD_TIMESTAMP",
  'S4_CURR' AS "SOURCE_SYSTEM",
  o."SOURCE_FILE",
  "d"."PurchaseOrder","d"."PurchaseOrderItem","d"."AccountAssignmentNumber","d"."PurchasingHistoryDocumentType","d"."PurchasingHistoryDocumentYear","d"."PurchasingHistoryDocument","d"."PurchasingHistoryDocumentItem","d"."PurchasingHistoryCategory","d"."GoodsMovementType","d"."PostingDate","d"."Currency","d"."DebitCreditCode","d"."IsCompletelyDelivered","d"."ReferenceDocumentFiscalYear","d"."ReferenceDocument","d"."Material","d"."Plant","d"."RvslOfGoodsReceiptIsAllowed","d"."PricingDocument","d"."TaxCode","d"."DocumentDate","d"."InventoryValuationType","d"."DocumentReferenceID","d"."DeliveryQuantityUnit","d"."ManufacturerMaterial","d"."AccountingDocumentCreationDate","d"."Quantity","d"."PurOrdAmountInCompanyCodeCrcy","d"."PurchaseOrderAmount","d"."QtyInPurchaseOrderPriceUnit","d"."GRIRAcctClrgAmtInCoCodeCrcy","d"."GdsRcptBlkdStkQtyInOrdQtyUnit","d"."GdsRcptBlkdStkQtyInOrdPrcUnit","d"."InvoiceAmtInCoCodeCrcy","d"."ShipgInstrnSupplierCompliance","d"."InvoiceAmountInFrgnCurrency","d"."QuantityInDeliveryQtyUnit","d"."GRIRAcctClrgAmtInTransacCrcy","d"."QuantityInBaseUnit","d"."GRIRAcctClrgAmtInOrdTrnsacCrcy","d"."InvoiceAmtInPurOrdTransacCrcy","d"."VltdGdsRcptBlkdStkQtyInOrdUnit","d"."VltdGdsRcptBlkdQtyInOrdPrcUnit","d"."IsToBeAcceptedAtOrigin","d"."ExchangeRateDifferenceAmount","d"."ExchangeRate","d"."DeliveryDocument","d"."DeliveryDocumentItem","d"."OrderPriceUnit","d"."PurchaseOrderQuantityUnit","d"."BaseUnit","d"."DocumentCurrency","d"."CompanyCodeCurrency","d"."ProductTypeCode","d"."IsStatisticalItem","d"."IsReturnsItem","d"."GoodsReceiptIsExpected","d"."GoodsReceiptIsNonValuated","d"."IsFinallyInvoiced","d"."InvoiceIsExpected","d"."PurchaseContract","d"."PurchaseContractItem","d"."AccountAssignmentCategory","d"."PurchaseRequisition","d"."PurchaseRequisitionItem","d"."PurchaseOrderItemCategory","d"."ServicePerformer","d"."ProductGroup","d"."MultipleAcctAssgmtDistribution","d"."PurgDocumentItemDeletionCode","d"."Supplier","d"."PurchasingOrganization","d"."PurchasingGroup","d"."CompanyCode","d"."PurchaseOrderType","d"."PurchasingDocumentDeletionCode","d"."ReleaseIsNotCompleted","d"."PurchasingCompletenessStatus","d"."Change_Type","d"."Change_Date"
FROM
  "1_INBOUND_S4_CURR.1LT_C_PURCHASEORDERHISTORYDEX_S4_CURR_Delta" d
  CROSS JOIN "2SV_ACTIVE_BATCH_S4_CURR_01" b
  JOIN "2LT_CTRL_LOAD_OBJECT_01" o ON o."BATCH_ID" = b."BATCH_ID"
  AND o."SOURCE_SYSTEM" = 'S4_CURR'
  AND o."OBJECT_NAME" = 'C_PURCHASEORDERHISTORYDEX'
